0153.name: Custom Pretendo Error
0153.message:
The online service is unavailable.
Please try again later.

For help, visit support.nintendo.com.
0153.long_description: Your console is using a uidhmac value that is no longer compatible with our services.
0153.short_solution: You must repair your uidhmac using the latest version of Nimbus.
0153.long_solution: Download the latest version of Nimbus and launch it. Press the START button. This will automatically apply the fix and reboot your console.
